About us

A student chapter with its feet in the community.

We are Enactus ARSD — the Enactus chapter of Atma Ram Sanatan Dharma College, University of Delhi — a team of students who believe entrepreneurial action can make life better for the people around us.

The organisation

Part of something bigger.

Enactus is a global network of student teams that use entrepreneurial action to address social challenges. Within that network, each chapter is a team rooted in its own campus and community.

Enactus ARSD is the chapter of Atma Ram Sanatan Dharma College, University of Delhi. Our members design and run social ventures alongside the communities they serve — from artisan livelihoods to mental-health support.

Affiliations

  • Enactus NetworkPart of the global Enactus network of student teams using entrepreneurial action.
  • ARSD CollegeEnactus ARSD is a student society of Atma Ram Sanatan Dharma College, University of Delhi.

What drives us

Mission, vision & values

A short statement of purpose — and the principles we hold while pursuing it.

Mission

To empower communities through entrepreneurial action — creating livelihoods, well-being and dignity with the people, not just for them.

Vision

A campus team that keeps proving social enterprise works at the smallest level first: one artisan, one gardener, one neighbourhood at a time.

Values

  • Human first — projects start from listening.
  • Integrity — we publish only claims we can stand behind.
  • Action — ideas count once they change something on the ground.
  • Learning — every project is as much for our members as its beneficiaries.

How we work

From listening to a working venture.

  1. Identify — pick a challenge where a small team can genuinely help.
  2. Design — with the community, shape a sustainable venture.
  3. Build — find partners, funding and routes to market.
  4. Sustain — measure, refine, keep it standing after we graduate.

Background

A chapter that has grown with its city.

Our published history begins with a visible push in 2020: projects Kalakaari and Srijan earning the chapter a KPMG Business Ethics Grant, and the first Ennovate — Enactus Day — on 5 February 2020. The team went on to compete at Enactus Nationals in 2022 with Project Samvedna and Project Srijan.

We are writing the rest of that history now — new projects, new partners, and the next generation of the core team. If you were part of an earlier chapter cohort, we would love to hear from you at enactusarsdchapter@gmail.com.
